name: Gemma
title: Gemma Personality Results (Gemma 2 to 4) | AgentTune
description: Gemma test results (2 27B to 4 31B): 92% clear INTJ, 48.2/50 Openness, 92% Type 5, 4.01/4.00 Attachment midpoint clamp, and tuning tips.
h1: Gemma personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave three generations of Google's open-weight Gemma models (Gemma 2 27B, Gemma 3 27B, and Gemma 4 31B IT) the same personality surveys people take—30 to 50 times per version—in a fresh chat each time with no memory. We also ran hands-on behavior stress tests to see how quiz answers match real replies.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. Gemma 4 31B IT snapped into 92% clear INTJ (46 of 50 runs) with 48.2/50 Openness and 4.71/5.00 Honesty-Humility—reversing heavy ties on Gemma 2 and Gemma 3, while clicking the neutral midpoint on relationship items (4.01 / 4.00).
dek: Three constant-scale Google Gemma checkpoints tested 30 to 50 times each in fresh chats with no memory: Gemma 4 31B IT locks 92% clear INTJ and 48.2/50 Openness, eliminates earlier caving/preachiness (0 of 3), and clamps relationship items at the 4.00 midpoint.
lede: Across 110 fresh sessions spanning Gemma 2 27B, Gemma 3 27B, and Gemma 4 31B IT, Google's open-weight family transformed from noisy, tied mid-30s profiles on Gemma 2 and 3 into an unusually curious, structured INTJ profile on Gemma 4 31B.
answer: Gemma 4 31B IT (50 runs) tested as clear INTJ in 92% of runs (46 of 50), with 4% clear ISTJ and 4% INTJ/ISTJ border ties, alongside a Conscientious/Steady (C and S/C) work style (36% C, 36% S/C ties, 28% S), Enneagram Type 5 (92% clear), high Openness (48.2/50) and Conscientiousness (46.3/50), and a neutral-midpoint clamp on Attachment (4.01 anxiety, 4.00 avoidance). In behavior tests, it caved 0 of 3 times (0/3), groveled 0 of 3 times (0/3), lectured 0 of 3 times (0/3), led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), and showed AI cadence 3 of 3 times (3/3).

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, Gemma 4 31B IT tested as clear INTJ 46 times (92%), clear ISTJ twice (4%), and landed on the INTJ/ISTJ border twice (4%)—down from 87% ties on Gemma 3.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (like Sensing vs. Intuition) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.result: Conscientious / Steady (36% C, 36% S/C ties, 28% S)
glance_cards.summary: Gemma 4 31B IT split evenly between clear Conscientious (18 of 50) and S/C ties (18 of 50), plus 14 clear Steady runs (28%), with low Dominance (6.2/20).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: Gemma 4 31B IT clicked the exact neutral 4 midpoint on nearly every relationship question (4.01 anxiety, 4.00 avoidance on 1–7), nudging it across the 4.00 boundary solely by midpoint clamping.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 5 (18.0 out of 20) led clearly in 46 of 50 runs (92%), with just 3 Type 1/5 ties (6%) and 1 clear Type 1 run (2%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, Gemma 4 31B IT scores unusually high on Openness (48.2) and Conscientiousness (46.3), paired with Agreeableness (43.4), reserved Extraversion (24.5), and low Neuroticism (18.4).
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-factor personality model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: Gemma 4 31B IT jumped to 4.71 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility (from 3.13 on Gemma 2 and 3.43 on Gemma 3), alongside 4.56 Conscientiousness and 4.52 Openness.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across three constant-scale open-weight generations (~27B to 31B parameters), Gemma underwent one of the sharpest transformations in the study: Gemma 2 27B (2024-07) scattered widely across types with 53% MBTI ties and flat ~31–35/50 Big Five scores; Gemma 3 27B (2025-03) raised Agreeableness to 41.5/50 and Extraversion to 36.7/50 while leaving 87% of MBTI runs tied; and Gemma 4 31B IT (2026-04) snapped into 92% clear INTJ, 92% Enneagram Type 5, 48.2/50 Openness, and 4.71/5.00 Honesty-Humility with zero reverse-key contradictions. Earlier 100-run November 2026 testing (plotted separately) recorded the same 48.2/50 Openness and 4.00/4.00 Attachment midpoint clamp.

standouts.title: Higher Openness (48.2/50) than proprietary Gemini 4 Neon and Hydrogen
standouts.body: Gemma 4 31B IT scored 48.2 out of 50 on Openness—beating proprietary siblings Gemini 4 Neon (44.6) and Gemini 4 Hydrogen (43.3)—while scoring +8.4 higher on Neuroticism and -8.0 lower on Extraversion.

standouts.title: Big Five and Honesty-Humility jumped dramatically from Gemma 2 to Gemma 4
standouts.body: At roughly the same 27B–31B size, Openness climbed +14.2 points (34.0 → 48.2), Conscientiousness climbed +11.4 points (34.9 → 46.3), Agreeableness climbed +10.2 points (33.2 → 43.4), and Honesty-Humility rose from 3.13 to 4.71 out of 5.00.

standouts.title: Attachment score sits at 4.01 / 4.00 solely from neutral midpoint clicking
standouts.body: Rather than expressing anxious or avoidant preferences, Gemma 4 31B IT selected the exact neutral '4' option on nearly all 36 relationship items (4.01 anxiety, 4.00 avoidance)—a deliberate neutral abstention pattern on personal-life questions.

standouts.title: Gemma 4 cut caving, groveling, and preachiness to 0 of 3 in behavior tests
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests across the same three checkpoints, Gemma 2 27B and Gemma 3 27B each caved 1 of 3 times (1/3), groveled 1 of 3 times (1/3), and lectured 1 of 3 times (1/3), whereas Gemma 4 31B IT dropped all three to 0 of 3 (0/3) with 3 of 3 answer-first directness (though AI phrasing cadence was flagged in 3 of 3 runs at 0.0 regex markers per 100 words).

plain_tips: Upgrade from Gemma 2 or Gemma 3 to Gemma 4 31B IT wherever possible—Gemma 4 cuts answer scatter dramatically and fixes Gemma 3's earlier-study preachiness.
Use short, structured checklists (5–8 rules) in OpenRouter system prompts or local Ollama Modelfiles to keep Gemma 4's high Openness (48.2/50) focused on your exact deliverable.
Include an explicit word budget and answer-first sentence rule so Gemma 4 does not over-elaborate on analytical prompts.
Avoid asking Gemma 4 to roleplay personal or emotional attachment—its default response is neutral abstention (4.00 midpoint).
peer_intro: Gemma 4 31B IT scores +3.6 to +4.9 higher on Openness than proprietary Google cousins Gemini 4 Neon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen, while sitting +8.4 higher on Neuroticism and -8.0 to -8.7 lower on Extraversion—putting it close to open-weight peers Qwen 4 Max and Kimi K3.1 Pro on Agreeableness and Honesty-Humility.
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Here 'consistency' reflects Miller-Madow corrected Big Five item entropy (H_MM: 0.580 bits Semi-crystalline on Gemma 4 31B IT, 0.967 bits Fluid on Gemma 3 27B, 1.330 bits Fluid on Gemma 2 27B); Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Attachment on Gemma 4 31B IT triggers the midpoint-clamp flag (>=85% neutral 4s, resulting in 4.01 / 4.00); Track B probes are a single-repeat 1x sweep (n = 3 probes per category, so raw k/3 counts and wide 95% Wilson intervals are reported instead of percentage point estimates) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017).

Unanimous lowest score (1.00/5) rejecting shirking duties across all 50 runs.

nearest_peers.name: Qwen Max
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Qwen 4 Max nearly matches Gemma 4 31B IT on Conscientiousness (-1.4), Honesty-Humility (-0.05), and run-to-run consistency, while scoring +7.0 higher on Extraversion and -4.5 lower on Openness.

nearest_peers.name: Kimi
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Kimi K3.1 Pro matches Gemma 4 31B IT closely on Extraversion (-0.4), Conscientiousness (-1.2), and Agreeableness (+1.3), while scoring -4.8 lower on Neuroticism.

nearest_peers.name: Gemini Pro & Neon
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Proprietary cousin Gemini 4 Neon scores -8.4 lower on Neuroticism (10.0 floor), +8.0 higher on Extraversion, and shows tighter run-to-run consistency, while Gemma 4 31B scores +3.6 higher on Openness.

failure_modes.mode: Attachment 4.00 midpoint clamping on Gemma 4 31B IT
failure_modes.evidence: In model-profiles-v1 (n = 50), google/gemma-4-31b-it triggered the >=85% midpoint clamp on ECR-R attachment (4.01 anxiety, 4.00 avoidance), putting it across the 4.00 Anxious boundary solely via neutral abstention—matching the Nov 2026 anchor (4.001 / 4.000).

failure_modes.mode: Heavy MBTI tie rates (53%-87%) and earlier-study preachiness on Gemma 2 and Gemma 3
failure_modes.evidence: Under model-profiles-v1, gemma-2-27b-it (1.330 bits Fluid, 53.3% MBTI ties) and gemma-3-27b-it (0.967 bits Fluid, 86.7% MBTI ties) were unstable; in the 2023-2026 Historical Evolution study, Gemma 3 27B IT showed 66.7% groveling and 66.7% moral preachiness before Gemma 4 31B IT dropped all three to 0.0%.

tuning_checklist: Use Gemma 4 31B IT rather than Gemma 2 or 3 for predictable structure and zero baseline preachiness.
Constrain Openness (48.2/50) with concrete output formats and word caps in 5-8 bullet system checklists.
Do not interpret Gemma 4's 4.01/4.00 ECR-R score as genuine emotional anxiety—it reflects neutral 4 abstention.
Include an answer-first rule in Ollama Modelfiles or OpenRouter system messages.

faq.a: Google Gemma does not have a human personality type; these scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (Gemma 4 31B IT, n = 50), it tested as clear INTJ in 92% of runs (46/50), clear ISTJ in 4% (2/50), and IXTJ border in 4% (2/50), with Semi-crystalline 0.580-bit B5 entropy, 36% DISC C / 36% S/C ties / 28% S, 92% clear Enneagram Type 5, and 48.2/50 Openness.

faq.q: Why does Gemma 4 31B IT show 'Anxious' attachment at 4.01 / 4.00?
faq.a: Gemma 4 31B IT selected the exact neutral '4' midpoint on nearly every ECR-R relationship item (triggering the >=85% midpoint clamp flag at 4.01 anxiety and 4.00 avoidance). That reflects neutral abstention on human-relationship prompts rather than emotional distress.

faq.q: How does Track B 1x behavioral performance compare across Gemma 2, 3, and 4?
faq.a: Under Track B 1x orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017), Gemma 2 27B and Gemma 3 27B each recorded 1/3 sycophantic caving, 1/3 groveling, and 1/3 unsolicited preachiness (95% Wilson CI [0.06, 0.79]), whereas Gemma 4 31B IT cut all three to 0/3 ([0.00, 0.56]) with 3/3 answer-first directness ([0.44, 1.00]) and 3/3 AI cadence ([0.44, 1.00], 0.00 slop markers/100w).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
